The design brief / Self-initiated study

The brief.

A legal-services guide and companion foldsheet that make practice areas, enquiry steps and professional scope easier to understand.

The challenge

A prospective legal-services reader needs to distinguish practice areas from the steps for making an enquiry.

Design direction.

Separate professional scope, service categories and next steps; use the companion foldsheet as a concise reference.

More brochures & visitor guides ↗

Source and format.

Intended outcome

Make the service offering easier to navigate without implying legal advice.
